newsitem.title: USA: Swing-N-Slide hurt by higher resin prices.
newsitem.headline: Swing-N-Slide hurt by higher resin prices.

text.p: Swing-N-Slide Corp, a manufacturer of do-it-yourself wooden playground equipment, said higher resin prices and an expansion of its product line contributed to its lower gross margin for the third quarter.

The company posted a third-quarter loss of $0.03 per share, compared with a profit of $0.01 per share in the same period a year earlier. Sales were $6.7 million, compared with $6.8 million in the 1995 quarter.
"Although results are below 1995, we are pleased with the progress of our cost savings and efficiency improvement programs as we prepare for 1997," said Chairman Richard Mueller in a statement.
He said the company's strategy called for continued expansion of several key programs in 1997.
"We are committed to making our precut kits available through more retailers next spring, based on the successful test program during this year," Mueller said.
"Additional resources will be allocated for marketing the commercial playground equipment line, which offers excellent value for a wide variety of customers," he said.
